get.summary: Get stock-per-store
get.description:
Returns daily stock levels for wholesaler's products.
Stock values updated approx 06:45 AM CET every day. "Try-it"-function works even without limiting parameters, but browser asks if you want to "Wait". Reply "Yes", until response "200 OK" is shown. Due to pagination issues, it will always take 15-30 secs for response even when parameter "maxResults" is used. (default 1048575 )

parameters.name: productId
parameters.description: Returns stock of products that match productId

parameters.name: storeId
parameters.description: Returns stock of products in the specified storeId

parameters.name: vendorId
parameters.description: Returns stock of products that match vendorId

parameters.name: manufacturerId
parameters.description: Returns stock of products that match manufacturerId

parameters.name: wholesalerId
parameters.description: Returns stock of products that match wholesalerId

parameters.name: changedSince
parameters.description: Returns stock of products that have been updated since the supplied date (yyyy-MM-dd)

parameters.name: productShortNameContains
parameters.description: Returns stock of products where productShortName contains the supplied string

parameters.name: includeZeroStock
parameters.description: Include products which are sold and its stock is 0 (zero)

x-total-count.description: Total number of records that satisfy the request criteria
